parts.official_mark_scheme_text:
Commence division and reach a partial quotient of the form $3x^3\pm3x^2$, or write $3x^4-2x^2=(x+1)(Ax^3+Bx^2+Cx+D)+Ex+F$ and reach $A=3$, $B=\pm3$ - M1. May be seen in synthetic division.

Obtain quotient $3x^3-3x^2+x-1$ - A1. Do not ISW. It need not be labelled if quotient and remainder are not muddled; if clearly muddled, M1A1A0 for both correct expressions.

Obtain remainder $1$ - A1. Do not ISW. Allow $3x^3-3x^2+x-1+1/(x+1)$, but not 'remainder $=1/(x+1)$'.

Alternative method: $f(-1)=3-2=1=$ remainder - B1; do not ISW. Use division, inspection or coefficient comparison - M1, e.g. $3x^4-2x^2-1=(x+1)(3x^3-3x^2+x-1)$. Obtain quotient $3x^3-3x^2+x-1$ - A1; do not ISW; same fractional-form guidance.

Printed total: 3.
